notes: Site: Umbraco-headless SPA (sostrenegrene.com), Denmark market at /da (culture=da-DK, market=DK). Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/block; robots.txt Allow: / with no Claude-specific disallow. Checked: main /da/produkter top-category tiles, footer nav, homepage content blocks, and the full /da/sitemap.xml (37k lines) grepped for 'nyhed' (news/new) and related terms. FOUND: /da/produkter/nyheder ('Nyheder' = 'News/New' -- the site's standard Danish term for newly-added products), a categoryDetails page (contentId 3681, title='Nyheder', crossCategory='news', categoryId=null -- this concept is queried via a crossCategory query param rather than a numeric categoryId). Queried the same backend listing endpoint the prior Home-Decor pass discovered (/umbraco/api/catalog/search) with crossCategory=news: total=383, sortBy='news', reproduced identical across 6 repeat calls (fresh sessions + delayed re-checks) and invariant to pageSize (1/500/1000 all returned total=383). Sample product names confirm a genuine sitewide new-arrivals listing spanning many categories (a wall-mounted drying rack, tealight candles, notebooks, palette knives, etc), not a single-category filter -- this is the site's own canonical, undifferentiated New Arrivals node (not nested under a parent; it did not appear as one of the main /da/produkter top-nav tiles but is a real first-class category page reachable from the sitemap and directly queryable). EXCLUDED after inspection -- two 'nyheder-til-X' landing pages found in the sitemap that looked like themed New-Arrivals sub-categories at first glance: (1) /da/landing/nyheder-til-kokkenet ('News for the kitchen') -- checked via curl -I and it 301-redirects to the plain general Koekkenudstyr (Kitchen Equipment) category page (/da/produkter/bolig/kokkenudstyr-c-8314), i.e. it is a retired/stale campaign URL that no longer has distinct New-Arrivals content -- not a real listing at all now. (2) /da/landing/nyheder-til-smuk-servering ('News for beautiful serving') -- a categoryId=2034/crossCategory='campaign' page, queried total=14 real serving products, but its own header art references 'Summer2026' and its subhead reads 'Se alle nyheder' (See all news) -- this is a small seasonal-themed marketing curation/highlight reel drawn from the same underlying new-arrivals pool already counted in the canonical 383-item 'Nyheder' node above, not a genuine site-taxonomy child category the way e.g. 'Furniture New Arrivals' would be -- excluded as a marketing sub-selection rather than double-counted or added as a separate child row. No genuine sub-structure (e.g. 'Furniture New Arrivals' / 'Lighting New Arrivals') exists in the site's own taxonomy for this concept -- only the single flat 'Nyheder' node -- so only one row is emitted per the brief's guidance not to invent sub-categories.
